relationship_to_historical_target: Separate bounded extension: flat parameter/species assignment and rate rules, Boolean/conditional operators, and numeric functions extend beyond frozen kinetic-core-v0.1; old corpus reuse is not target conformance.

syntax.assignment_rules: target := expr; and inline species/formula/const/var/$ declarations with :=.
syntax.rate_rules: target' = expr; (including spaced target ' = expr;) and inline species/formula/const/var/$ declarations with '=.
syntax.empty_rule_rejections: Empty rule syntax (a := ;, a' = ;, EOF or newline before RHS) rejects UnsupportedFeature; never silently clears or drops rules.
syntax.prime_rejections: Uncoalesced prime tokens (in expressions or followed by ==) reject Syntax.

semantics.ownership_and_replacement: Same-kind rules replace the formula (last wins) while retaining previously inferred symbols and first-seen target order; mixed assignment/rate rules on the same symbol reject DeclarationConflict.
semantics.initialization_interaction: Assignment rules clear prior '=' initializations; '=' after ':=' rejects DeclarationConflict. Rate rules preserve independent '=' scalar or InitialAssignment initialization.
semantics.lexical_scalar_export: Assignment-rule targets populate SBML scalar attributes and public value()/initial_concentration() getters only for verified lexical finite bare numeric/-numeric forms; grouped, unary-plus, rational, Boolean, or constant expressions do not.
semantics.species_boundary_promotion: Source-order-sensitive: promoting an already-ruled non-species to species sets boundaryCondition=true unless a later var species overrides it; assigning a rule to an already-declared non-boundary species keeps boundaryCondition=false; non-boundary ruled species in reaction stoichiometries reject DeclarationConflict.
semantics.dependency_cycles: Assignment rules participate in the algebraic dependency graph alongside '=' initializations; source-prefix transient cycles reject InitializationCycle before rule replacement.
semantics.dimensions: Assignment rules require target and RHS dimensions to match when both are Known; rate rules require Known RHS dimensions to equal Known target minus Known model time_unit.

retained_exclusions: Compartment assignment and rate rules (dynamic compartments)
Reaction assignment rules replacing kinetic laws
Algebraic rules (0 = expr) and empty rule clearing (a := ;)
Events, delay, user-defined functions, and submodel hierarchy
All textual infix/prefix logical aliases, comparison chains, XOR, and implies
Nonfinite constants and existing scalar/rational restrictions
A solver or general simulation-readiness guarantee
